privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Moj Budzet is built to keep your finances on your own device. This page explains what data the app uses and where it is kept.

data.title: What you enter
data.body: Transactions (merchant, amount, date, category, note), categories, budgets, savings goals, your starting balance, monthly income and settings (theme, language). The app does not ask for your name, email or phone number.

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.body: All data is stored only on this device, in the app's storage. There is no account and no server. The app does not add its own encryption, so protect your device with a passcode or biometrics.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: If device backups (iCloud or Google) are turned on, the operating system may include the app's data in them, according to your device settings.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: The app does not send your data anywhere. There are no ads, analytics or tracking. Your data only leaves the app when you export it.

suggestions.title: Category and budget suggestions
suggestions.body: Suggestions are calculated on the device from the data you enter. Nothing is sent over the internet.

rights.title: Your control
rights.body: In Settings you can export all of your data or delete it. Uninstalling the app also deletes its data from the device.

children.title: Children
children.body: The app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect their data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If the app ever starts using data differently, this page will be updated before that happens.
